lead: No tier in this repository draws a decoration, so a change to how one looks is unverified until someone opens an editor.
body: `test:headless` runs the reveal state machine and the position conversion in plain Node, and the extension-host tier does not render; the README's *No pixel tier* says why neither will. A CSS change here is a proposal, not a landed fix — say so, and get it looked at before writing it down as one.
